title: The guard asks before a push past a reviewed head that already has a fix check
why: At 18:44 CST Nov 7 the coordinator told lane mixed-merge-resolver to add Fix lines on #1683's reviewed head. That moved the head past its review record, and the merge tool could not chain a second fix check.
note: Fix: the guard asks before a push to a lane branch whose head has a passing review record and whose PR already has a fix check, and names "stack it on a new branch" as the remedy. Repair of the incident (coordinator pick, 18:54 CST, can be undone): revert those commits on #1683 and move the lines to the stacked PR. #1871 sighting (lane process-held-end-to-end, 06:54 CST Nov 8; filed as reviewed-head-push-warns, folded here): a docs commit pushed to #1871 after its one fix check moved the head off its done record; the cost is a fresh rounds 1-3 chain. Nothing warned before the push. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was archived, handoff at handoffs/session_013NEJL36oZi9XZ76KB8nFQy.md on archive/session-handoffs-2026-11-10). Lane code-handoffs-2 started 07:29 CST Nov 12 (coordinator fan-out, Sonnet, medium). Folded in push-after-fail-owes-record (lane code-handoffs-2, 08:53 CST Nov 12, at the coordinator's ask): the earlier case. On #2685 (step handoff-keeps-owner-waits) the lane pushed a round-3 fix before posting the review record at the reviewed head 4844e93792; merge --review-record --fix-check then refused, since it needs a posted record whose Head is the reviewed head and cannot print one for a stale head. Cost: one extra review read and a re-record at the new head. Second trigger for the same guard: a push to a lane branch whose newest review round at the live head is FAIL and no record comment names that head; remedy "post the review record at the reviewed head first: merge <pr> --review-record --head <sha> ...".
